engine.dataFlow: crypto → store → brain → voice, with contracts as the shared schema spine.

modules.name: @lar/crypto
modules.blurb: PBKDF2-600k · AES-256-GCM · per-note DEK · BIP39 recovery
modules.exports: Keyring (create / unlock / rewrap / recovery), encryptSecret / decryptSecret, seal / open.
modules.guarantee: The master key lives only in memory; a tampered iteration count fails closed.

modules.name: @lar/store
modules.blurb: Local-first encrypted document store + sync engine + backup
modules.exports: createStore / openStore, EncryptedStore, SyncEngine, memory + localStorage adapters.
modules.guarantee: Adapters only ever see ciphertext — proven by the end-to-end no-leak chain test.

modules.name: @lar/contracts
modules.blurb: The data model: zod Note / Block / Link / Topic + extraction
modules.exports: Note/Block schemas, extractLinks, extractTags, noteText, makeNote.
modules.guarantee: A persisted Note never leaks title or body plaintext (the sev-0 test).

modules.name: @lar/brain
modules.blurb: Indexer · reversible Actions · Router · fail-closed Firewall
modules.exports: buildIndex, applyActionPlan (exact inverses), route, createFirewall + ledger, captureThought.
modules.guarantee: Personal content routes on-device; nothing egresses un-redacted; every action undoes exactly.

modules.name: @lar/voice
modules.blurb: STT / Cofounder / TTS seam + VoiceSession barge-in FSM
modules.exports: SttEngine / CofounderStream / Tts interfaces, VoiceSession, deterministic mocks.
modules.guarantee: The cloud is reached only on ASK, only after the firewall — and barge-in cancels it mid-flight.

modules.name: app · src/brain
modules.blurb: seed (150 notes) · graph · recall · capture — feeds the 3D brain + chat
modules.exports: SEED_NOTES, buildBrainGraph, recall / rankNotes / brainSuggestions, fileThought.
modules.guarantee: Deterministic — no clocks, no randomness: the same brain on every reload, every machine.
